agent_explanation: Right boundary-wall collision fails to reflect/constrain the fast body: vx stays exactly 13.718 across steps 130-140 while x marches from 18.32 through contact (~19.17) to 19.329 outside, overshoot growing 0.058 to 0.159. No impulse or positional correction is applied at the arena wall, so the body leaks out. Reducing dt removes the failure, pointing to discrete contact resolution missing the wall at larger per-step motion.
